summary: Light pale-blue offshore staffing page: a hero stage with slide tabs along its lower edge, an intro beside four figure tiles, a logo row, an award grid, a carousel of roles by industry, a savings calculator, three photo steps, a talent pool split, three quote cards and a contact form.

sections.note: pale blue ground: heading, lead and two pill buttons left, a large award or badge graphic right; four slide tabs with a title, one line and a thin progress bar on the active tab run along the bottom, with a 01 / 04 counter and arrows
heading and two paragraphs left, a two-by-two bento of tiles right: small index, a large badge, icon or figure, a two-line caption and a round arrow; two tiles filled in the brand blue, two light
centered heading over one row of client logos and a one-line caption
centered heading and line, two rows of five certificate and award badges in cells split by thin lines, each with a caption

centered heading and line, a sideways track of tall white cards with a blue top edge, an icon square, the industry name, a check list of roles and a View all roles link, with a progress bar under the track
heading, a lead with a bold accent phrase, two small figure boxes and a pill button left; a browser-framed savings table by role right
centered heading and line, three cards joined by a thin line, each with a photo, a large blue numeral, a title and a paragraph, a pill link to the FAQ below
one large rounded card: heading, paragraph, three tick chips and a pill button left; a grid of candidate portraits with role labels on a blue shape right
heading and line at the left, three quote cards with a quote mark, number, the quote fading into a Read full story pill and the author with initials and title, a pill button below
large heading, a line and three small value chips with a pill button left, a white consultation form card right (name, email, company, job title, source, details, consent)
